name: neotype-studio
description: Neotype Studio — custom stickers, banners and corflute signs. Static site with a Cloudflare Pages Function for pricing, admin, orders and Stripe checkout.
//: No dependencies on purpose. Cloudflare Pages runs npm install whenever this file declares any, and the Pages Function uses only Workers built-ins (fetch, crypto.subtle, KV and R2 bindings). An empty dependency list means there is no install step that can fail the build.
